plain_conclusion: 外部前沿定理已经能给出真实副产品：Baker-Harman-Pintz 2001 禁止长度约 P^0.05 以上的连续空行串；若 Runbo Li 2025 预印本被接受，可把指数改进到 P^0.04。Xylouris/Meng 的 Linnik 型结果保证列方向最终出现素数，但高度仍为 P^5 或 P^4.5 量级，不能进入 P^2 方阵；Li-Zhang-Cai 的 P2 almost-prime 结果进入 P^2，却正好是错误奇偶对象。故所有有帮助的外部定理都已定位为 side bounds/parity diagnostics；目标命题仍需要 theta<=1/2 的点态短区间定理、Linnik<=2 的同窗口常数版本、theta=1/2 二阶矩到行格点的转移，或真正非线性破奇偶构造。

rows.payload: Every large interval of length x^0.525 contains a prime.
rows.transformed_payload: For x~P^2 this forbids prime-free row runs longer than P^0.05 up to constants.
rows.helps: Closes a genuine side theorem: no asymptotically long consecutive empty-row block of exponent >0.05.
rows.obstruction: Target row theorem needs theta<=1/2, i.e. empty-run exponent <0.

rows.payload: Claims every large interval of length x^0.52 contains a prime.
rows.transformed_payload: If accepted, this improves the empty-row run exponent bound from 0.05 to 0.04.
rows.helps: Best known-looking pointwise short-interval candidate located in this audit.
rows.obstruction: Still has theta=0.52>1/2 and is preprint status; it does not give one prime in each P-long row.

rows.payload: Uniform short-interval PNT at exponents theta>17/30.
rows.transformed_payload: For x~P^2 this gives row windows of size P^(17/15+o(1)), weaker than BHP/Li for pointwise row closure.
rows.helps: Important for zero-density and exceptional-set technology, but not the pointwise row gate.
rows.obstruction: 17/30>1/2; pointwise length is still too long.

rows.payload: Relates zero-density estimates to exceptional sets; records all-x theta>17/30 and almost-all theta>2/15 context.
rows.transformed_payload: Almost-all x control does not imply control on the rigid lattice endpoints kP or P^2-row blocks.
rows.helps: Useful for density-style side bounds and for checking that row-grid control is the missing interface.
rows.obstruction: Needs lattice/grid transfer from continuous exceptional measure to every P-spaced row endpoint.

rows.payload: Least prime in a reduced residue class mod q is O(q^5.2).
rows.transformed_payload: For q=P this gives a column prime by height P^5.2, far beyond the P^2 square.
rows.helps: Confirms the AP route is real but much too weak for P x P column closure.
rows.obstruction: Column theorem needs Linnik exponent <=2 with compatible constants/window.

rows.payload: Improves the general Linnik exponent below 5.
rows.transformed_payload: For q=P this is still height P^(5-o(1)), not P^2.
rows.helps: Best general published direction found for least prime AP, still not target-compatible.

rows.payload: For moduli with bounded cubic part, least AP prime is O(q^4.5).
rows.transformed_payload: Prime modulus P is structurally compatible with bounded cubic part, but P^4.5 is still outside the P^2 square.
rows.helps: Stronger special-modulus AP side theorem; gives no column closure.
rows.obstruction: Exponent gap 2.5 above the needed L<=2 threshold.

rows.theorem: Li-Zhang-Cai 2021 least P2 almost-prime in AP
rows.payload: Least at-most-two-prime-factor number in a reduced residue class is O(q^1.8345).
rows.transformed_payload: For q=P this enters the P^2 square, but it is an almost-prime, not a prime.
rows.helps: Sharp parity-barrier diagnostic: the AP sieve reaches the square for P2, not for primes.
rows.obstruction: Wrong parity object; cannot replace column prime existence.
